Dear HCI colleagues,

We’re hiring a 2-year Research Engineer for the TACIT project:

Work on accessible AR/XR for remote sign language interpretation. Focus areas include real-time AR interaction, spatial interpreter presentation, adaptive visual interfaces, and multimodal feedback.

The role is strongly prototype-driven. PhD not required. The position is in close collaboration with me, Pablo César (CWI), Floris Roelofsen (UvA), Maartje De Meulder (HU Utrecht), and situated partly at LAB42 UvA / SignLab Amsterdam.

Apply by Sept 4, 2026:
We look forward to you applications, Abdo
